austin.summary: Austin, drafting 5th meant waiting all night, and then you landed Eric at pick #16 — a guy who ranks 1. Carter ranks 1 too. That's a back half of the draft that did heavy lifting, even with a draft GPA of 2 and the Torch Collector badge hanging around your neck, 2 torches snuffed. You sit rank 3 of 5 with 32 counted points, the leader has 44, and 40 points are still on the table. You're in this.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Carter and Eric are both sitting at 11 pts and rank 1 of 21, and they're the 2 of 4 you've still got in the game.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Jenna was your reach at pick #6 and finished rank 17 of 21 with 4 pts and a grade F after going 4th voted out in Ep 4 — the same episode that was your worst week at +3.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Whether your merged-tribe duo can keep stacking the way they did in Ep 3, your best week at +8, with 40 points still out there to chase down that 44.

kylie.summary: Kylie, you drafted 3rd, and Ep 1 hit you first and hardest — Aaliyah at pick #3 went home immediately, your worst week at +3, and a First Blood badge nobody wants. Add Torch Collector with 2 torches snuffed and a 2.25 draft GPA, and you sit rank 5 of 5 with 27 counted points. But hear me: 40 points are still on the table, the leader has 44, and Kilby at pick #18 is a steal.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Cristian and Kilby are both sitting at 11 pts, tied at rank 1 of 21, and they're the entire engine of this team.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Aaliyah at pick #3 scored 0 pts and finished rank 21 of 21 — a reach that cost you from the opening night.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Whether that Ep 6 surge of +8 becomes the new normal, because with 2 of 4 still in the game, every point your merge duo banks closes the gap on 44.

tami.summary: Tami, you drafted first and you drafted bold — three of your five are still out there on Mergedtribe, and you're sitting at rank 2 of 5 with 36 counted points off a raw 38. Sharonda at pick #21 as the leftover is the steal of this entire draft, and Ep 6 gave you your best haul at +12. The leader has 44. There are 55 points still on the table. Game on.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Jelly, Mike and Sharonda are all tied at 11 pts and ranked 1 of 21 — three co-leaders hauling your scoreboard together.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Patt at pick #10 scored 3 pts for a rank of 18 of 21 and an F grade, and Rob's 2 pts became your dropped score under the best-4 rule.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Your Idol Whisperer badge says this roster has found 2 idols and advantages — watch whether that hardware turns into points at the merge.

taylor.summary: Taylor, you took Kristin at pick #2 and then stole Brady at #19, and right now both of them sit tied at 11 pts, rank 1 of 21. That's a top of the roster nobody can sneer at. The middle, though? Rough. A 1.75 Draft GPA and only 2 of 4 still in the game has you rank 4 of 5 with 30 counted points. But there are 40 points still on the table and the leader has 44. You're alive.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Kristin and Brady are doing all of it — 11 pts apiece, both rank 1 of 21, both still in the game on Mergedtribe.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Ana at pick #12 was the reach of your draft, going out 2nd on Ep 2 with 1 pts and a grade F, and Ori followed her out the door in Ep 6.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: You've already got the Torch Collector and Idol Whisperer badges with 2 idols found — see if that idol luck keeps feeding your two survivors down the stretch.

tim.summary: Tim, you drafted fourth and somehow you're first — rank 1 of 5 with 44 counted points and all 4 of 4 still breathing out here. Eight boots, none of them yours. Untouchable. Merge Machine. Wire-to-Wire. A 3.75 draft GPA and Thien An falling to you at pick #17 is the kind of larceny we usually only see at Tribal. Ep 1 gave you +4, Ep 6 gave you +16. The family's chasing you.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Nobody's carrying it alone — Lewis, Maggie, Devin and Thien An each sit at 11 pts, rank 1 of 21, a four-headed monster at the top of the board.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Lewis Kelly's B grade is the only blemish on an otherwise straight-A roster, and that Ep 1 +4 is a reminder slow weeks happen.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: There are 70 points still on the table and the leader has 44 — plus your crew's already sniffed out 2 idols and advantages, so keep an eye on what they dig up next.
